status: starter vocabulary from the template, not yet agreed

auth.description: Sign-up, sign-in, password reset, email verification, two-factor authentication and session handling.
auth.not: Who may do what once signed in (access-control).

access-control.description: Roles, permissions, policies and gates: who may see or change what once authenticated.
access-control.not: Establishing identity in the first place (auth).

admin.description: Operator and staff-facing administration surfaces and the settings they manage.
admin.not: Anything a public visitor or end user sees (public-site).

public-site.description: Pages and flows served to unauthenticated visitors, including marketing content and lead capture.

notifications.description: Email, SMS and in-app notifications: templates, channels, delivery and retry.
notifications.not: The business events that cause a notification, which belong to the area that owns the event.

payments.description: Taking, refunding and reconciling money, payment provider integration and webhooks.
payments.not: Subscription plans and what each plan includes, if billing is a separate concern in the product.

security.description: Security controls that span areas: input safety, rate limiting, secrets handling, audit logging and data protection.
security.not: Ordinary authentication flows (auth) or role rules (access-control).

infrastructure.description: Hosting, deployment, CI, queues, caching, storage, monitoring and the local development stack.
infrastructure.not: Application features that merely run on the infrastructure.
